tasks.name: 创建博客数据模型
tasks.description: 设计博客的数据模型，包括标题、描述、图片链接和评论字段，并保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 创建评论数据模型
tasks.description: 设计评论的数据模型，包括评论内容、作者信息和关联的博客ID，并保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 实现博客API接口
tasks.description: 开发博客的后端API接口，支持创建、读取、更新和删除博客内容。

tasks.name: 实现评论API接口
tasks.description: 开发评论的后端API接口，支持添加评论、读取评论和删除评论功能。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 开发后端图片上传功能，支持用户上传图片并保存图片链接到数据库。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 设计博客的前端页面，支持用户创建博客，上传图片，并显示博客列表。

tasks.name: 创建评论前端功能
tasks.description: 设计评论的前端功能，支持用户在博客页面下添加评论并显示评论列表。

tasks.name: 设计明亮放松的页面样式
tasks.description: 设计博客页面的整体样式，采用明亮和放松的配色方案，优化用户体验。

T1.implementation_approach: Define a database model with fields like title, content, author, created_at, and updated_at.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for search functionality.

T2.implementation_approach: Create a model with fields such as blog_id, user, comment_text, and timestamp.
T2.notes: Establish a foreign key relationship with the blog model.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the blog model.
T3.notes: Implement authentication and pagination for listing blogs.

T4.implementation_approach: Create API endpoints to add, edit, delete, and fetch comments linked to specific blogs.
T4.notes: Include validation to prevent spam or inappropriate content.

T5.implementation_approach: Use a library or service like AWS S3 to handle image uploads and store URLs in the database.
T5.notes: Validate file types and size before uploading.

T6.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end page using a framework like React or Vue to display blogs.
T6.notes: Integrate API calls to fetch and display blog data dynamically.

T7.implementation_approach: Implement a comment form and display section using JavaScript to interact with the comment API.
T7.notes: Add real-time updates for new comments using WebSockets or polling.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a light-themed UI with soft colors and ample white space using CSS or a design framework like Tailwind.
T8.notes: Focus on readability and user comfort for extended browsing.
